all_callback_function_inventory.name: mount
groups
all_callback_function_inventory.source: (ids,i)=>ctx.ui.choice({id:`semester-task-${i}`,label:W('我要辦什麼？','What do I need?','何をしたい？'),options:ids.map(id=>({value:id,label:taskBy(id).label})),value:'',onChange:id=>{if(dead)return;const r=selectTask(state,id);if(!r.accepted){groups[state.round]?.setValue(state.selectedTask||'');ctx.hint(W('這件諮詢已完成，請選本幕還沒處理的事。','That consultation is complete. Choose a remaining question in this act.','その相談は完了しました。この幕の残りを選ぼう。'));return;}state=r.state;windows.setValue('');render();ctx.hint(taskBy(id).next);}})

Choose a remaining question in this act.','その相談は完了しました。この幕の残りを選ぼう。'));return;}state=r.state;windows.setValue('');render();ctx.hint(taskBy(id).next);}

all_callback_function_inventory.name: windows
all_callback_function_inventory.source: id=>{if(dead)return;const r=selectWindow(state,id);if(!r.accepted){windows.setValue('');ctx.hint(W('先選你要辦的事，再判斷窗口。','Choose your question before choosing a contact.','先に用事を選び、それから窓口を考えよう。'));return;}state=r.state;render();ctx.hint(W('窗口選好了。移動到這站，再按「到站詢問」。','Contact chosen. Move to that stop, then Ask here.','窓口を選びました。移動して「ここで相談」を押そう。'));}

all_callback_function_inventory.name: render
go
all_callback_function_inventory.source: d=>{if(dead)return;const r=move(state,d);state=r.state;if(!r.accepted){ctx.hint(W('到了圖邊，換個方向。','Map edge reached. Try another direction.','地図の端です。別の方向へ。'));return;}ctx.sound('click');render();}

ctx.ui.text('semester-stops',W('圖上位置：系辦在左上，註冊課務組在右上，授課教室在下方中央。圖像只代表窗口。','Map key: department office at upper left, Registration and Curriculum Section at upper right, classroom at lower centre. Icons stand for contacts only.','図の左上は学科事務室、右上は註冊課務組（学籍・履修担当）、下中央は教室。絵は窓口の記号です。'))
